description: ImpAI builds (tagpu/ddraw/src/tagpu_impai.c; the brain, impai_brain.c, impai_econ.c, impai_build.c): Comet Catcher with fixed starts, true line of sight, mapped, at Easy, so both branches of every handicap stub the economy reaches run each pass. Seat 0 is an idle human (ARM, StartPos1) with a Peewee on hold about 1100 world units south of seat 1's start (5184, 560); seat 1 is ImpAI (CORE, StartPos2, so the launch writes `seatai=1`) and seat 2 OTA AI (CORE, StartPos3) with two A.K.s on hold about 350 south-east of its start (5712, 7216). The `impai-eco` test group orders the Peewee onto seat 1's commander at GameTime 900, so the on-hit commander purge's site (row 18) runs on ImpAI's branch; it cannot kill the commander: the Peewee's EMG does 8 a shot every 0.4 s, and its range, 180, is inside the CORE commander's laser's 200, which ends it in four shots (the retail FBIs and weapons.tdf). Nothing attacks seat 2: a stock AI commander that is hit drops its orders and pauses its builder planner 30 to 329 ticks a hit (0x406F80), so a Flea's beam every 0.8 s kept seat 2 from giving any order from GameTime 1212 to the end (MEASURED 2026-11-12, the recording's order lists). Its A.K.s make its orders hold by construction: the attack planner 0x4077E0 orders one to three armed mobile units home every 300 ticks, whatever the economy (engine/orders.md, the force planners). Comet Catcher has 3 to 7 metal spots within 1024 of each of its first four starts and a wind of 10..15 (scout I11), so the extractors come from spots and the energy from solar.
